court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Learned Judicial Magistrate No.II, Coimbatore (CC.No.855 of 2010)
case_name: Tmt. V.Savitha Devi vs Dr. S.Kalaikumar

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Tmt. V.Savitha Devi, Thiru G.Venkatesh, Thiru J.Balachander, Thiru V.Devarajan

facts_of_case: Petitioners are accused in CC.No.855 of 2010. They borrowed money from respondent and issued cheques which bounced. Respondent filed cases against petitioners under Section 138 of Negotiable Instruments Act.

legal_principles.principle: The words 'any proceeding' used in Clause (B)(1) of Sub Section 1 to Section 195 Cr.P.C. are words of wide amplitude and have no limitations except that the proceedings should be before a Court.
legal_principles.held: These words are very general and are wide enough to cover a proceeding in contemplation before a criminal Court, though it may not have begun at the date when the offence was committed.
use_in: case type: complaint against cheque bounce

legal_principles.principle: The offence must have been committed 'in or in relation to any proceeding in any Court'.
